name: telegram-amazon-orders-returns
description: Polls your own Amazon account for order, delivery, return, and transaction activity (via the unofficial amazon-orders library) and pushes updates to Telegram, including return drop-off QR codes. No web UI - interact through Telegram bot commands (/orders, /delivered, /transactions, /returns, /status). Optionally publishes active-orders/returns-in-progress/recent-deliveries counts to Home Assistant via MQTT.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent Amazon session cookies and the sqlite tracking DB. Do not delete between restarts - the session is stored here.

variables.name: Amazon Email
variables.description: Amazon account email address to poll.

variables.name: Telegram Chat ID
variables.description: Your personal Telegram chat id (from @userinfobot). Only this chat is served.

variables.name: Poll Interval Minutes
variables.description: How often to poll Amazon for new orders/transactions, in minutes.

variables.name: MQTT Host
variables.description: Optional: MQTT broker hostname/IP, to publish order/return/delivery counts to Home Assistant. Leave blank to disable.

variables.name: MQTT Topic Prefix
variables.description: Topic prefix for published sensor values.

variables.name: MQTT Retain
variables.description: Retain published sensor values so Home Assistant has them immediately on restart. Discovery configs are always retained regardless.
